title.narrative: Feasibility Studies and Designs in Somalia

description.narrative: As part of the Somalia Urban Resilience Project Phase 2 (SURP II), UNOPS is to support the project implementation units in Beledweyne and Dhusamareeb and directly implement feasibility studies and designs for road construction. The objective of the proposed service is to study and prepare prioritized investment packages for improvement of city services. This includes the rehabilitation of urban roads, including their drainage systems, if needed, development of a public park within the city. Assess the bridges and provide recommendations for the safe usage of the two existing steel bridges. \n
